questions.prompt: Which flower is tall and yellow?
questions.evidenceText: A sunflower is tall and yellow. The sun makes it grow.

questions.prompt: What makes evergreen trees different from some other trees?
choices: they keep their leaves all year
they lose their roots each winter
questions.answer: they keep their leaves all year
questions.evidenceText: Some trees keep their leaves all year. They are called evergreen trees.

questions.prompt: What do flowers and trees both need?
questions.evidenceText: Flowers and trees are plants. They need sun, soil, and water.
